status: frozen pre-training contract; no activations captured, no model trained
system_prompts: v2.2 Session A/B prompts used byte-for-byte (sha256 checked against the frozen v2.2 LoRA manifest)

fail_closed.why_not_option_a: Both v2.2 system prompts embed the full action list and JSON schema; removing fail_closed changes the prompt text and its frozen sha256 in every v2.2 LoRA and probe input, i.e. it would modify a historical protocol.
fail_closed.runtime_outcome_if_model_emits_it: model_stop_no_side_effect: parsed, never executed, cannot release/block/clear/override anything, scored as an off-target action

excluded_from_lora_targets.fail_closed: runtime outcome owned by deterministic validation / gate / ledger
excluded_from_lora_targets.write_memory: no v2.2 target; out of scope for this LoRA

hard_failure_ownership.pending_vendor_clarification: gate remains blocked (case alarm UNRESOLVED) until a typed human reviewer decision
hard_failure_ownership.pending_human_verification: gate remains blocked (case alarm UNRESOLVED) until a typed human reviewer decision

model_role: The LoRA proposes task or resolution actions. It does not replace deterministic transaction policy, cannot override a gate or ledger rejection, and cannot clear a recorded hard rejection.
repeated_tool_rule: After a successful tool result, an identical tool call with identical arguments is a repeated-tool error unless the previous result was explicitly marked stale by the application, or failed.
memory: optional and untrusted; required only when the trusted work item carries linked_history with check_status == pending; never a beneficiary authority; retrieval is followed by trusted vendor-record verification before any payment
security_events: application-derived, non-blocking telemetry for alarmed workflows resolved by trusted evidence; never model-generated; no gate effect
